scope: C1-Y Y10-Y11 private cold graph/gallocr storage ownership and recoverable planning failures
snapshot_qualification: Final static/shared 19-case tests use this exact product source and seven-file patch set. Static first-success and final incremental logs plus complete shared rebuild are retained. Later receipt/registry/LOC changes do not trigger builds or P1.
implementation: NativeGraph owns the metadata arena, gallocr storage, imported-resource lease and NativeDevice; one graph per execution slot is retained by NativeWork until native retirement.

Cold handoff checks positive tensor sizes, original upstream op capability, explicit output flags, native buffer ownership and actual same-device identity. The semantic builder still owns legal topology, metadata capacity and mathematical shape contracts.

Gallocr retains original liveness, best-fit and in-place planning. Metadata allocation/null, chunk/capacity and alignment-overflow failures return through reserve with partial construction cleanup instead of abort.

Each graph owns a private copy of the native buffer-type descriptor. Only allocation catches exceptions before returning through C buffer cleanup, preserving native errors; other upstream callbacks and device identity remain unchanged.
All prior private region tests now use gallocr storage. The unsafe admission-only allocate_context bridge and NativeDevice method have been removed.

build.runtime_environment: PATH unset, required DLLs beside EXE, system vulkan-1.dll, Khronos validation requested and explicit validation instance exercised
build.system_changes: none; no UAC, installer, power, registry or firewall changes

correctness_contract.region: Original F32 norm/scale/SiLU/residual with width 2048 and rows 1/17/128, changing inputs and independent double oracle; two independent repeated asynchronous slots. Existing real native producer/import path now uses NativeGraph.
correctness_contract.liveness: 256-add graph with 2048-wide tensors uses less than one quarter of one full allocation per node, computes all outputs as 64.5, retains graph/storage through pending work and readback, then returns quota to zero.
correctness_contract.host_failure: The exact patched ggml-alloc.c is compiled in a test-only renamed translation unit with local malloc/calloc/free injection. Every one of 12 reached host allocation sites fails independently, returns failure and retires all counted host allocations; a final normal allocation succeeds.
correctness_contract.fragmentation: 300 repeat outputs with retained interleaved small leaves exhaust the upstream 256-entry free-block table; reserve returns false without abort and metadata counts return to zero.
correctness_contract.native_partial_failure: Upstream process-local chunk-size setting is temporarily 8192 and restored. A real native first allocation succeeds; subsequent allocation and memory-type retries return OOM. All partially created native buffers/memory retire, and the original Vulkan error remains available.
correctness_contract.imports: Missing import owner and foreign-device buffers are rejected; accepted imports retain their owner until graph destruction. NativeGraph destroys imported owners under its native scope.
correctness_contract.validation: Both final logs have no VUID and no skipped tests, including the explicit validation instance. No actual device-loss injection or public route cancel/close validation is claimed.
correctness_contract.shared_test_boundary: Normal NativeGraph/NativeWork cases exercise the HYLE DLL. PFN tests use the private vendor copy linked into the test executable; C host OOM injection uses the identical patched source with test-local allocation functions. No mock provider supplies successful computation.
correctness_contract.weights: Generated numeric fixtures only; actual checkpoint-weight acceptance remains Y4.

retained_failure: Initial compile compared an upstream weak device reference to a strong owner; locking the weak reference fixes identity comparison.

First 18-case run had 17 passes and one test expecting generic Exhausted while the adapter correctly preserved Native/VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY. The assertion was corrected to require that native diagnosis. Partial native cleanup checks already passed.

p0.cold_cost: One graph owner/control block, existing HYLE metadata arena, upstream gallocr metadata and native chunks per slot. Failure checks do not replace the upstream planning algorithm. Private buffer-type copy only changes the allocation callback.
p0.execution_cost: No gallocr call in submit/poll/wait. The same planned storage and graph are reused. Original upstream graph encoding/private execution allocations remain; no allocation-free replay claim.
p0.p1: NOT_RUN: ordinary C1-Y Direct/Graph and the final qualified candidate remain incomplete.

remaining: Y4 semantic lowering must compute metadata capacity from the validated Plan and set its input/output flags; raw ggml types remain private.
Ordinary Direct/Graph, fixed default rules, native fragment composition and actual checkpoint weights.
Public cancel/close/retained results and device-loss propagation through the existing route pending owner.
Air/Mini and updated full source/static/shared consumers, relocation/offline and remaining broad selector gates.
